title: Finding and removing single points of failure

kcs.statement: A single point of failure is any component whose failure alone takes the whole system down; find them by tracing the request path and asking what happens if each component dies.

Remove a single point of failure by adding redundancy, such as a second load balancer sharing a floating IP, database replicas or several app servers, including often-forgotten ones such as DNS, a single region or one config service.
